Research_Objective: Measure potential returns from buying calls when the market rises
Hypothesis_Statement: Purchasing ATM/near-OTM call options during confirmed bullish momentum produces positive net yield after Indian F&O slippage and statutory STT/brokerage
Required_Market_Data: Spot, CE LTP, CE Delta, CE IV, Volume
Validation_Criteria: Profit Factor >= 1.35 after statutory taxes; Net Win Rate >= 38%; Max Drawdown <= 15%; Positive Expectancy
Unresolved_Decisions: Strike selection by delta (0.50 vs 0.35) vs strike offset; Initial SL percentage vs ATR multiple; Profit booking model (fixed R:R vs trailing SL)

Research_Objective: Measure potential returns from buying puts when the market falls
Hypothesis_Statement: Purchasing ATM/near-OTM put options during confirmed bearish momentum captures rapid downside volatility expansion yielding positive net returns
Required_Market_Data: Spot, PE LTP, PE Delta, PE IV, Volume
Validation_Criteria: Profit Factor >= 1.35 after statutory taxes; Net Win Rate >= 38%; Max Drawdown <= 15%; Positive Expectancy
Unresolved_Decisions: Strike selection criteria (ATM vs OTM); Volatility crush mitigation rule; Fixed target vs trailing stop-loss

Research_Objective: Determine whether market movement can exceed the combined option premium and trading costs
Hypothesis_Statement: Simultaneous long ATM CE and ATM PE during anticipated volatility expansion generates gross gains exceeding dual-leg theta decay and doubled transaction costs
Required_Market_Data: Spot, ATM CE LTP, ATM PE LTP, IV Percentile, VIX
Validation_Criteria: Net P&L positive across > 50 trades; Win Rate >= 30%; Average Win to Average Loss ratio >= 2.5; Transaction cost drag < 25% of gross profit
Unresolved_Decisions: Holding period duration (intraday only vs multi-day event holding); Dynamic delta rebalancing requirement; Leg exit independence vs combined premium exit

Research_Objective: Test whether cheaper farther-out-of-the-money strikes improve results
Hypothesis_Statement: Buying OTM CE and OTM PE reduces upfront premium outlay and theta decay rate
Instrument_Type: allowing asymmetric payoff during large directional breakouts
Target_Regime: Spot, OTM CE LTP (Delta 0.25), OTM PE LTP (Delta 0.25), VIX
Unresolved_Decisions: Net Profit Factor >= 1.3; Payoff Ratio >= 3.0; Drawdown recovery within 20 trading sessions
Status: Optimal strike distance (Delta 0.20 vs 0.30 vs fixed 150-pt offset); Exit when single leg hits target vs combined P&L threshold

Research_Objective: Test whether the market remains sufficiently range-bound to justify the premium-selling risk
Hypothesis_Statement: Selling simultaneous ATM CE and ATM PE collects dual-leg time decay profitably when market realized volatility remains below implied volatility
Required_Market_Data: Spot, ATM CE LTP, ATM PE LTP, Combined Straddle Premium, Gamma
Validation_Criteria: Sharpe Ratio >= 1.5; Net Win Rate >= 62%; Max Daily Loss <= 3.0% of allocated capital; Tax drag < 20% of gross profits
Unresolved_Decisions: Shift-to-cost trigger logic; Combined SL vs individual leg SL (20% vs 25% vs 30%); Overnight positional risk handling (strictly prohibited on mobile/Termux)

Research_Objective: Evaluate the relationship between strike distance premium income and risk
Hypothesis_Statement: Selling OTM CE and OTM PE at varying strike distances provides wider breakeven boundaries that offset tail-risk blowups during normal market distributions
Required_Market_Data: Spot, OTM CE LTP, OTM PE LTP, Delta Ladders, IV Skew
Validation_Criteria: Profit Factor >= 1.45; Net Win Rate >= 68%; Maximum Drawdown <= 12%; Tail-risk loss containment
Unresolved_Decisions: Delta-based strike selection (0.15 vs 0.20 vs 0.25 delta) vs fixed point distance (200 vs 300 pts); Adjustment rules when one side is breached

Research_Objective: Test limited-risk profitability under defined range conditions
Hypothesis_Statement: Selling an OTM credit strangle while simultaneously buying outer wing hedges defines maximum potential loss while capturing theta decay in range markets
Required_Market_Data: Spot, Short CE/PE LTP, Long Wing CE/PE LTP, Combined Margin
Validation_Criteria: Net Win Rate >= 65%; Profit Factor >= 1.30; Zero tail risk (100% loss-bounded by wing spread); Calmar Ratio >= 1.2
Unresolved_Decisions: Wing hedge distance (300 vs 500 vs 600 pts); Intraday 15:15:00 exit vs holding through weekly expiry; 4-leg atomic fill simulation order queue

Research_Objective: Evaluate whether a two-option structure controls cost and maximum risk
Hypothesis_Statement: Buying an ATM call while selling an OTM call finances entry premium and caps downside risk while maintaining favorable risk-reward in moderately bullish trends
Required_Market_Data: Spot, Buy CE LTP, Sell OTM CE LTP, Futures Basis
Validation_Criteria: Win Rate >= 45%; Profit Factor >= 1.40; Net Expectancy per lot >= ₹450 after all statutory charges
Unresolved_Decisions: Spread width (100 vs 150 vs 200 pts); Roll-over rules if underlying advances beyond upper strike; Intraday square-off vs expiry holding

Research_Objective: Test whether following trends produces positive net results
Hypothesis_Statement: Systematic trend following on NIFTY near-month futures captures sustained directional momentum with linear payoff
Required_Market_Data: NIFTY Futures LTP, Futures Volume, VWAP, SuperTrend, EMA
Validation_Criteria: Profit Factor >= 1.40; Total Trades >= 100 across out-of-sample data; Net Win Rate >= 40%; Max Drawdown <= 10%
Unresolved_Decisions: Trend identification filter (EMA crossover vs SuperTrend vs VWAP slope); Trailing stop-loss methodology; Intraday vs carrying overnight futures margin

Research_Objective: Measure whether the put's cost is justified by the reduction in futures downside risk
Hypothesis_Statement: Holding long NIFTY futures paired with an ATM/OTM long put caps maximum adverse excursion while allowing upside participation
Required_Market_Data: Futures LTP, Put LTP, Put Delta, Put IV
Validation_Criteria: Drawdown reduction > 40% compared to naked futures; Net Sharpe Ratio superior to benchmark naked futures
Unresolved_Decisions: Put strike selection (ATM vs 1% OTM); Put expiration cycle (weekly vs monthly); Timing of hedge re-balancing or profit harvesting

Research_Objective: Test whether the market reverses after an opening gap
Hypothesis_Statement: Opening index gaps between current open and previous close tend to fill due to intraday liquidity replenishment and mean reversion
Required_Market_Data: Previous Close, Today Open, Opening 5M Range, VIX
Validation_Criteria: Win Rate >= 55%; Profit Factor >= 1.35; Gap fill success rate statistical significance (p < 0.05)
Unresolved_Decisions: Minimum gap size threshold (e.g. 0.3% vs 0.5% vs 0.8%); Time limit for gap fill attempt (e.g. 10:30:00 cutoff); Stop-loss placement beyond day's high/low

Research_Objective: Test whether the market continues in the direction of the opening gap
Hypothesis_Statement: Large opening gaps driven by macro or earnings momentum break out and trend strongly in the gap direction without filling
Required_Market_Data: Today Open, Previous Close, High/Low, Volume Surge
Validation_Criteria: Win Rate >= 42%; Payoff Ratio >= 2.0; Profit Factor >= 1.40; Out-of-sample consistency
Unresolved_Decisions: Criteria separating gap fade from gap continuation (Volume surge threshold, constituent sync); Breakout validation buffer (ticks above opening range)

Research_Objective: Evaluate whether EMA signals provide useful forward-looking trading information
Hypothesis_Statement: Fast and slow exponential moving average crossovers generate directional trade signals with trend confirmation
Required_Market_Data: NIFTY Futures LTP, Fast EMA (9/13), Slow EMA (21/34/50)
Validation_Criteria: Profit Factor >= 1.30; Net return exceeding benchmark buy-and-hold; Total trades >= 150 across test partitions
Unresolved_Decisions: Optimal EMA parameter pairs (9/21 vs 13/34 vs 21/50); False signal filtering mechanism (ADX filter vs Volume confirmation); Instrument selection (Futures vs ATM Options)

Research_Objective: Test whether changes in open interest add useful information
Hypothesis_Statement: Significant call/put open interest accumulation and unwinding at key strikes identifies institutional support/resistance and impending price squeezes
Required_Market_Data: Open Interest Changes, PCR Ratio, Strike OI Build-up, Volume
Validation_Criteria: Statistically significant edge over random baseline (p < 0.01); Win Rate >= 52%; Profit Factor >= 1.40
Unresolved_Decisions: OI change threshold (e.g. +20% strike OI change); PCR extreme levels (0.7 oversold vs 1.4 overbought); Signal confirmation latency requirement

Research_Objective: Test whether rule-based hedge adjustments improve risk-adjusted results
Hypothesis_Statement: Dynamic delta and vega hedge adjustments on existing positions mitigate severe market shocks and reduce drawdown volatility
Required_Market_Data: Portfolio Net Delta, Spot Momentum, VIX, IV Skew
Validation_Criteria: Overall portfolio Sharpe ratio improvement >= 20%; Maximum drawdown reduction >= 30%; Hedging cost friction < 35% of saved capital
Unresolved_Decisions: Delta threshold triggering hedge adjustment (+/- 0.30 net portfolio delta); Hedging vehicle (Futures vs Deep OTM Options vs Micro Lots); Re-balancing cooldown period
